svg.text: Ladder logic 3/3 · Door confirm, relabel loop, alarms
Line B mirrors line A · doors 2-6 mirror door 1 · ONS = one-shot (R_TRIG in Structured Text) · .DN = timer done
Door 1 confirm scan: right truck = green + count it, wrong truck = hold + red
Relabel station A: belt waits with a package until the operator presses Done
Gap timer: line A join eye must be clear 0.6 s before re-inducting
Return belt A slides the fixed package back onto line A, ahead of the tunnel
Red stack light flashes on a jam or an open E-stop
